title: Don’t bother
text: I’m really frustrated. I’m going to go with A better subscription box. The colors are ugly and it’s mostly makeup. It used to be a good mix of skincare and makeup. This time I got ONE item I’ll use. The past 3 I got 1 Or few items I use. The rest will be given away. Boxy is a much better value since you can pick and choose colors etc. I’m not wearing 90’s brown lipstick ever again, it’s ugly. I’m also not wearing orange lipstick huda; I don’t care how trendy it is I’m not wearing it. Also who gives lashes with no glue? I don’t feel this is particularly worth the price. If you have money to waste, maybe but not worth it when other better boxes are 5$ more.
label: negative
